answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 16 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in pulse, checked in umber, and echo reveals each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 2400 identities would post 2946 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
